thread:
Morgan: Quick preflight — cutting release/* tomorrow morning at 09:00 PT. Quick checklist and asks:
- who is owning the version bump? (pkg + helm)
- any changelog entries outstanding?
- backport rules: do we allow non-critical cherrypicks after cutoff with owner signoff?
- heads up: two folks on PTO day-of (cc @Priya).

Devon: I can take the version bump (pkg). Happy to pair with whoever does helm.
Also will open a tiny PR for the README note.

Sasha: Changelog: I have one UX item queued, will push today. Anything else needs a short blurb.

Priya: I’ll be OOO from 09:30–17:00 PT tomorrow — can still approve small PRs before I leave. If something needs testing after lunch, ping Andre. :wave:

Andre: If we need helm bump, I can do it in the 08:00 window (pre-cut). Prefer we avoid last-minute template changes.

Morgan: Thanks. Rules proposal: hard cutoff = branch create at 09:00 PT. After that, only emergency/security fixes allowed and must have 2 approvers + release lead signoff. Non-emergency cherrypicks get queued for next micro. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Devon: +1 to the rule. Suggest we add an exemption for docs-only or changelog-only trivial changes — auto-merge with one reviewer?

Sasha: Docs-only ok, but prefer at least one reviewer. We had a doc regress once and it was annoying.

Priya: Agree with Morgan on signoff for anything code-y. For changelog-only, fine to be lenient but please mark PR title with `[changelog]`.

Morgan: Good call. Process summary to put in the release channel:
```
- Branch created at 09:00 PT (release/x.y.z)
- After cutoff: only emergency/security fixes with 2 approvers + release lead signoff
- Changelog/docs-only: label `[changelog]` and one reviewer is fine
- Version bump: pkg owner = Devon, helm owner = Andre (08:00 pre-cut window)
- Release lead: Morgan
```
Will post this once Devon confirms pkg PR.

Devon: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4823 — bump to v1.14.0, small README note. Tagging @Andre for helm.

Katy-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — please ensure CHANGELOG.md updated and release-notes draft created. (automated)

Andre: Saw the PR, will prepare helm bump at 08:00. Quick Q: do we want a canary tag on the branch or straight branch creation?

Morgan: Straight branch creation. We’ll do small canary deploys from the branch later if needed, but keep cut simple.
If anyone has last-minute items, drop them now. Otherwise I’ll post the cut policy in #releases and set the branch timer. :rocket:
